scope: Candidate-only finite ambient-occlusion bake on the player-facing surfaces of the licensed V7 west wall (normal.x > 0.5) and adjacent ground triangles centered at x (-24.1,-20), z (-20,-12); evaluate contact detail before expanding or publishing.
source_mode: Geometry-derived Cycles AO from existing approved Blender/CC0 assets; no new painted art, direct lighting, environment color or combined bake.

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque glTF environment with a non-color occlusion atlas; no chroma key or UI text.

uv_policy: Preserve original UV0 and licensed wall UV1. Add TEXCOORD_2 only to receiver primitives. Nonreceiver triangles of receiver batches use a reserved white atlas coordinate. Preserve all original per-corner attributes, topology and world transforms; vertex duplication only for UV seams.
material_policy: Keep original embedded image bytes and all PBR fields. Add a single shared occlusion texture to receiver materials, strength 0.55. Collider materials and geometry are untouched.
gates: per-corner geometry normals original UV parity
PBR source image and material parity except intended occlusion
atlas density gutter and finite UV
original versus white control versus AO captures
sun and shade high and low quality visual review
stop_rule: Reject if darkening is broad rather than local, if atlas seams or bleed appear, if source geometry/material parity fails, or if the density/performance budget is not met. Do not expand a failed pilot into the full map.
